## 0.2.0 (2026-10-31)

### 🚀 Features

- **devtools:** add local read-only MCP access (MAE-899) ([#345](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/345))
- Add `@maelstrom-co/devtools-protocol` and `@maelstrom-co/devtools-mcp-server` for configured local DevTools collectors.
- ⚠️  **engine:** add ui-only streaming connections (MAE-857) ([#346](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/346))

### 🩹 Fixes

- **planners:** retain usage and cancellation before sdk filtering ([#360](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/360))

### ⚠️  Breaking Changes

- The `Engine` interface requires `openConnection`. Custom implementations and mocks must add it. The reference `createEngine` factory provides it.
- `ui_only` acceptance frames require a server-minted `runId`. The wire version remains 1 and is still unstable.

### Dependency assessment

Workspace tooling uses patched redirect and pattern-matching dependencies.
LiveKit retains two moderate advisories in its separate `throws-check` CLI
dependency chain. The voice worker does not invoke that CLI.
See the [consumer dependency assessment](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/blob/main/docs/dependency-audit-exceptions.md#sdk-consumer-dependencies).
